verdict.rationale: The Freshsales pricing page lists "Sandbox" as a product feature, so the product itself appears to offer a sandbox environment. Nothing in the pack describes how it works, whether it is isolated from production data, or whether it can be reached through the API for agent-driven testing. The 21-day trial is a separate offering and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of sandbox isolation from production data, how to provision and sync it, API/agent access to the sandbox, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
